title: Soma death state
notes: Soma's death state is ported; game-over flow, restart and save integration are absent.
next_action: Port the native game-over flow and its save integration.

title: Axe armor, its axe and the probe walker
divergences: The axe's on-screen rotation direction is inferred; sub_0803E058 is not traced.
notes: Walking with the native probe walker, patrols, high and low throws, the returning axe and the death are ported; explosions and effects are not.
next_action: Port the death explosions of sub_08045CEC and the one-way platform mode of sub_0806C828.

title: Bat enemy
notes: Bat hanging, swoop, combat and falling death are ported; its explosion particles and the global 0x8E & 0x40 state are not.
next_action: Port the bat explosion particles and its special state.

title: Blue crow enemy
divergences: ArcTan2 follows the mGBA high-level BIOS polynomial, not checked against the BIOS itself.
notes: Perching, the homing flight behind the player and the falling death are ported; the feathers, sounds, hit stun and the unentered glide step are not.
next_action: Port the crow feathers of sub_080C9E2C and the hit stun of sub_0806AD24.

title: Skull archer and its arrows
divergences: The pieces' attacker position is Soma's, standing for the weapon entity.
notes: Standing, volleys from the ROM table, patrol and retreat, sticking arrows, death and the flung pieces (generic debris) are ported.
next_action: Port the strike and dust effects of sub_0806D5C0 / sub_08045CEC.

title: Zombie and generic enemy death
notes: Zombie spawning, terrain walking and generic death are covered; the complete enemy framework is not.
next_action: Extend the generic enemy framework to further native enemies.

title: Zombie soldier and its grenade
notes: Walking, close attack, grenade throw, bounce, explosion box and death are ported; the gibs, explosion particles and sounds are not drawn or played.
next_action: Port the explosion particles of sub_0806D894 / sub_0806D644 and the gibs of sub_08092FCC.

title: Native wooden doors
notes: Wooden and green doors are functional in exported rooms; this does not cover every transition or special door.
next_action: Cover the remaining native transition and special door kinds.

title: Keyboard and gamepad input
divergences: Host input layer: SDL3 devices are mapped to the GBA KEYINPUT bits; the native key reading and repeat logic are not ported.
notes: Hot-plugged SDL3 gamepads, a remappable GBA layout and the keyboard drive Soma; no in-game controls menu yet.
next_action: Port the native input routines and add an in-game controls menu.

title: Soma movement and state controller
notes: Movement and the currently traced ability states are ported; the full native player state machine is not complete.
next_action: Port the remaining native Soma states.

title: Soma weapon entity and attack boxes
notes: Weapon classes 0, 2 and 3 are represented; the other native classes and their effects remain open.
next_action: Port the remaining native weapon classes and effects.

title: Sprite particles and debris
divergences: Particle sounds, the super missile screen shake and debris splashes are not ported; with all debris slots taken the game writes past its array while the port drops the piece; other particle effects (Samus, charge, dust, beams other than the normal beam) are not ported.
notes: One-shot particles for sprite explosions, the screw attack kill and projectile impacts on walls and sprites, the medium dust effects, with slot reuse, animation, priority and the on-screen window; sprite debris with its eight arcs, bounces, animation and draw range.
next_action: Port the remaining particle effects with their owners (Samus, charge beam, dust).

title: Samus animation and palette reconstruction
notes: The deterministic private library maps the currently supported semantic actions; native effects and every pose are not yet covered.
next_action: Extend coverage to native effects and the remaining poses.

title: Samus and room Clipdata collision
notes: Room Clipdata and the Samus collision subset are active; special blocks and all environmental effects remain incomplete.
next_action: Port special blocks and environmental Clipdata effects.

title: Dessgeegas and the Long Beam Dessgeega
divergences: Freezing, the sounds and the screen shakes are not ported; door locks are only reported (gDoorUnlockTimer is not consumed by the runtime) and removed floor blocks keep their background graphics; nothing sets EVENT_VIEWED_STATUE_ROOM yet and the event spriteset that places the Long Beam Dessgeega is not exported, so that variant only runs in tests.
notes: Ground and ceiling Dessgeegas share the Sidehopper state machine with their own tables and sizes; every ground Dessgeega death sets the Long Beam event and unlocks the doors (the game's bug, kept). The Long Beam variant checks its events, locks the doors, waits hidden from Samus and projectiles, drops through the floor removing three blocks with dust and debris, and lands on the next one.
next_action: Export the event spritesets and port the statue room event and the door lock lifecycle.

title: Rippers
divergences: Freezing and the damaged and death sounds are not ported; missiles that would tumble off a Ripper are removed.
notes: Brown and purple Rippers: init, random direction, horizontal patrol with wall turns, two-part turn animation, damage only from super missiles and the screw attack, death with its explosion into drops.
next_action: Port freezing with the ice beam.

title: Sidehoppers
divergences: Freezing and the jumping, landing, head shake and damage sounds are not ported.
notes: Ground and ceiling Sidehoppers: idle or head shake for 1 to 4 loops (work1 kept at 0 on spawn, as without BUGFIX), Samus detection within five blocks, jump warning, high or low jumps from the ROM tables with the head hitbox resized, wall bounces, falls when unsupported, landing and the single-then-big death explosion into drops.
next_action: Port freezing with the ice beam.

title: Skrees and their explosion
divergences: Freezing and the sounds are not ported; the explosion parts are drawn by rotating the composed frame around the sprite position (the native per-part position rotation, without its integer rounding or affine clipping).
notes: Green and blue Skrees: detection range, spin, dive with sSkreeFallingSpeed and the growing drift toward Samus, landing, the four impact debris, the crash timing, the huge explosion and the four spinning explosion parts as secondary sprites with their own damage, removed off screen.
next_action: Port freezing with the ice beam.

title: Wavers
divergences: Freezing and the damaged sound are not ported.
notes: Wavers start toward Samus and bounce diagonally between surfaces at their native speeds, dying into drops.
next_action: Port freezing with the ice beam.

title: Zeelas and the red Zeela eyes
divergences: Freezing, the damaged sound and the falling splash are not ported; the eyes rotate as a composed frame without the affine clipping.
notes: Zeelas reuse the Zoomer crawler with their speed, hitbox, ground X flip, single slope table and faster falling and landing animations; the red Zeela throws two spinning eyes that stop on solid collision or Samus and explode.
next_action: Port freezing with the ice beam.

title: Sprite engine core, the Zoomer and sprite combat
divergences: Hard-mode and event spritesets are not loaded; SpriteCheckOnScreen uses the GBA screen size while the runtime view is wider; missiles that would tumble off a sprite are removed; the stun palette flash, freezing and the damaged and death sounds are not ported.
notes: Room sprite placements, sprite graphics, the sprite RNG, animation and collision core, sprite families (a family whose OAM tables are missing is reported and disabled alone), secondary sprites (SpriteSpawnSecondary), whole and per-part rotation, the Zoomer crawl, turns and falls, Samus contact damage with knockback and screw attack kills (one hurting contact per frame), beam and missile hits, stuns, and death with its explosion particle into enemy drops are ported.
next_action: Port the stun palette flash and freezing, then further enemies (Sova, Viola, Geega, Zeb, Reo).

title: Keyboard and gamepad input
divergences: Host input layer: SDL3 devices are mapped to the GBA KEYINPUT bits; the native key reading and repeat logic are not ported.
notes: Hot-plugged SDL3 gamepads, a remappable GBA layout and the keyboard drive Samus; no in-game controls menu yet.
next_action: Port the native input routines and add an in-game controls menu.

title: Enemy drops
divergences: Power bombs are not ported, so their drops never spawn; pickup sounds are not played; PSPRITE_MULTIPLE_LARGE_ENERGY is not ported.
notes: Drop rolls from the ROM probabilities with the full energy and ammunition substitutions, the hidden spawn, pickup refills, blinking and despawn timers, and the common sprite graphics are ported.
next_action: Port power bombs and the multiple large energy pickup.

title: Samus pose and physics controller
notes: The room runtime covers a tested subset of poses and transitions, not the complete native controller.
next_action: Port the remaining native pose handlers.

title: Doors, hatches and room transitions
notes: Room-runtime door travel and hatch animation are partial; native fades, locks, events and lifecycle are not complete.
next_action: Port native fades, hatch locks and door lifecycle events.

title: Beam and missile projectiles
notes: Power Beam, missiles and super missiles move and collide with the room; their hits on ported sprites (damage, stun, invincible hits) and their wall and sprite impact particles are ported. Charge beams, beam upgrades, bombs, Power Bombs and tumbling missiles are not.
next_action: Port charge beams, beam upgrades, bombs, Power Bombs and tumbling missiles.
